All three are running, starting from main at 694c301.

1. "README: How to run section" (TC2SEC1) is running visibly in tmux for you, on Sonnet 5.5 (medium effort) on claude-second.
2. "Unit test for an untested pure function in src" (T4HA3RT) is in its implement step on Opus 5.5 (high effort) on claude-second. Every exported pure function on main already has a test since TRAAZCQ, so I pointed it at `page()` in `server.ts`. It will move it unchanged into `src/web/html.ts` and test it there, the same way `escape` was handled.
3. "Empty state on the customers page" (TAFEFXT) is in its implement step on Opus 5.5 (high effort) on claude-second. It needs a browser test for the empty state.

Expect another round of landing conflicts. The repo's changelog check means all three have to add a line to `CHANGELOG.md`, and tasks 2 and 3 both edit `server.ts`. I told both to keep their edits to `server.ts` narrow. Last time, "Land now" made Jev add a resolve step before landing, so a conflict costs one extra short session and nothing is lost. If you'd rather avoid it, I can make task 3 wait for task 2.

While reading the code I found a money bug. `lineTotalCents` does `Math.floor(unitPrice * 100)`, and in JavaScript `19.99 * 100` is `1998.9999999999998`, so a €19.99 line comes out as 1998 cents. Any price that doesn't convert exactly loses a cent. The existing test only uses whole prices, so it doesn't catch this. I haven't opened a task because you asked for exactly three; I'll open a bug task if you want it fixed.
"README: How to run section" (TC2SEC1) landed on main as 5499602. Lint and tests passed. The README now has a "How to run" section. It says Node 20 or later is required and lists all five package.json scripts, each with its exact command and a one-line description, and `scripts/owner-only.sh` is left out. There's also one new changelog line.

One small inconsistency, and it's my doing. The README's older intro line says `npm ci` for setup, while the new section says `npm install`, because that's the wording I put in the brief. Since the repo has a lockfile, `npm ci` is the more reproducible choice. It's a one-word fix, and I'll fold it into a task if you want it changed.

The unit-test task (T4HA3RT) and the empty-state task (TAFEFXT) are still running. Main now has one more changelog line, so a changelog conflict when they land is even more likely.
